basic_details.job_title: KPESRB Junior Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Kerala Public Enterprises (Selection & Recruitment) Board has invited online applications for one contract post of Junior Manager (Personnel) in Kerala State Textile Corporation Ltd, under Category No. 025/2026. The consolidated pay is Rs 35,000. Applicants need MBA (Human Resources Management) or MSW (Personnel Management) and 2 years' post-qualification experience in an HR department. Applications opened on 20-11-2026 and close on 19-12-2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum age of 36 years as on the date of notification. Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable to eligible candidates as per rules; the notice prints no relaxation table.

qualification.details: MBA (Human Resources Management) / MSW (Personnel Management) from a UGC recognized University, National Institutes established by the Central Government, or Institutions established by the Government of Kerala. The qualification must be the one obtained after a regular course of study. Applications with the above qualifications only will be considered.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted only through online mode; applications through any other medium are summarily rejected. The notice does not print the application website address or step-by-step instructions. It sets these conditions for the online application:
Upload the essential qualification and essential experience certificates while applying. Applications of those who fail to upload them are summarily rejected.
Give a valid email ID and mobile number, because all correspondence on the recruitment goes to the registered email ID and mobile number given in the online application.

To claim reservation benefits where applicable, upload a valid and updated Caste Certificate, Community Certificate, Non-Creamy Layer Certificate or EWS Certificate, as the case may be. Without valid certificates no reservation benefits are granted.
Caste / Community / Non-Creamy Layer / EWS certificate, as the case may be
The application fee is Rs 600/-, and Rs 150/- for SC/ST candidates. The notice does not state how the fee is paid.
important_instructions: Applicants should go through the notification and satisfy themselves about their eligibility before applying. Any form of canvassing or attempt to influence the selection process results in disqualification. The Board reserves the right to modify, postpone or cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Candidates are advised to keep a print out of the completed online application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: About KPESRB and Kerala State Textile Corporation
content_sections.text: The Board is based at Vellayambalam, VikasBhavan P.O, Thiruvananthapuram, and issued this notification. Kerala State Textile Corporation Ltd is a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1956. It is a Public Sector Undertaking under the Industries Department, Government of Kerala, with seven textile Mills across Kerala and one textile testing lab.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: MBA (Human Resources Management) / MSW (Personnel Management) from a UGC recognized University, National Institutes established by the Central Government, or Institutions established by the Government of Kerala. The qualification must be the one obtained after a regular course of study. Applications with the above qualifications only will be considered. Minimum 2 years' post qualification experience in the HR department of a Government/Quasi Government or a Public/registered Private Sector Industrial Undertaking. Maximum age of 36 years as on the date of notification. Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable to eligible candidates as per rules; the notice prints no relaxation table. The notice clarifies that community reservation for appointments is not applicable to contract appointments. Separately, it says SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates get reservation benefits as per rules if they upload valid and updated certificates; the special note on contract appointments applies to this post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: KPESRB Junior Manager (Personnel) Job Description
content_sections.text: Maintain employee records, personnel files, and HR databases. Process appointments, promotions, transfers, and leave, attendance, and retirement matters. Monitor attendance, absenteeism, and shift schedules. Assist in maintaining industrial relations and liaise with employees and trade unions. Ensure compliance with labour laws, standing orders, and company policies. Coordinate employee welfare schemes, employee amenities and statutory benefits. Organize employee training and development programmes. Prepare personnel reports, correspondence, and manpower statements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KPESRB Junior Manager (Personnel)
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only through online mode; applications through any other medium are summarily rejected. The notice does not print the application website address or step-by-step instructions. It sets these conditions for the online application: Upload the essential qualification and essential experience certificates while applying. Applications of those who fail to upload them are summarily rejected. Give a valid email ID and mobile number, because all correspondence on the recruitment goes to the registered email ID and mobile number given in the online application. To claim reservation benefits where applicable, upload a valid and updated Caste Certificate, Community Certificate, Non-Creamy Layer Certificate or EWS Certificate, as the case may be. Without valid certificates no reservation benefits are granted. Essential qualification certificate Essential experience certificate Caste / Community / Non-Creamy Layer / EWS certificate, as the case may be The application fee is Rs 600/-, and Rs 150/- for SC/ST candidates. The notice does not state how the fee is paid.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says admittance to the written examination/skill test/interview will only be provisional. The Board may decline to evaluate a candidate's performance, and reject the candidature, if a material discrepancy is found in the application or credentials at any stage. The notice does not say which of these stages apply to this post.
